claim_boundary: Conceptual, reversible public learning facilities; not approved monuments or engineering designs.

landmarks.daily_function: view test purpose, boundary, version, steward and physical stop
landmarks.accessibility: step-free bypass, tactile notice, audio/plain-language alternative
landmarks.safety_boundary: outside equipment logistics and isolated-test line
landmarks.reversible_build: ballasted demountable frame; dimensions subject to professional review
landmarks.stop_condition: stop or notice failure, crowd conflict, heritage/ecology conflict

landmarks.daily_function: touch/read provenance, licence, human contact, withdrawal and version history
landmarks.accessibility: seated and standing reach; non-screen route
landmarks.safety_boundary: keeps fire egress and basic passage open
landmarks.reversible_build: surface-mounted marker and movable archive table
landmarks.stop_condition: unverifiable licence/source, blocked passage, unresolved resident/fire issue

landmarks.daily_function: parallel human service, AI demonstration, inclusive co-test and appeal
landmarks.safety_boundary: no mandatory device/account/face gate; crowd plan required
landmarks.reversible_build: modular tables, signs and removable service stack
landmarks.stop_condition: basic access, human fallback, withdrawal or red-line KPI failure

honour_display_system.rule: Display verifiable contribution, failure, repair, provenance and licence; no personality cult or unlicensed name/logo/portrait.
